metadata.question: Does the snow cover in northwestern Pennsylvania increase between February 22, 2020, and March 1, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use MODIS daily snow cover (primary: MODIS/061/MOD10A1; fallbacks: MYD10A1 and 006 versions). Query two windows: [2020-02-22, 2020-02-23) and [2020-03-01, 2020-03-02). If empty, try Aqua and 006, then widen window by ±1 day. 2. Masking strategy: Mask to valid snow values 0–100 in NDSI_Snow_Cover (exclude clouds/no-decision). Compute valid pixel counts, total pixel counts (at 1000 m), and mean snow % over valid pixels. Cloud/invalid % = 100*(total - valid)/total. 3. Valid Zero vs Null/Error: If collections empty => C1. If valid pixel count == 0 => C2. If mean is null/NaN or outside [0,100] => C3. Otherwise compare mean snow % on Mar 1 vs Feb 22; increase => A, else B. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function getInfo(obj) { return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { obj.getInfo((res, err) => { if (err) reject(err); else resolve(res); }); }); } function nwPennsylvaniaGeometry() { // Approximate NW Pennsylvania bounding box (covers Erie, Crawford, Mercer, Warren, Venango, Forest) return ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-80.7, 41.0, -78.4, 42.5], null, false); } async function fetchSnowImage(targetDateStr, geom) { const datasets = [ 'MODIS/061/MOD10A1', // Terra v61 'MODIS/061/MYD10A1', // Aqua v61 'MODIS/006/MOD10A1', // Terra v6 'MODIS/006/MYD10A1' // Aqua v6 ]; const target = ee.Date(targetDateStr); const windows = [ {start: target, end: target.advance(1, 'day'), label: '±0d'}, {start: target.advance(-1, 'day'), end: target.advance(2, 'day'), label: '±1d'} ]; for (let w of windows) { for (let ds of datasets) { const col = ee.ImageCollection(ds) .filterBounds(geom) .filterDate(w.start, w.end) .select('NDSI_Snow_Cover'); const size = await getInfo(col.size()); if (size > 0) { const img = ee.Image(col.sort('system:time_start').first()); const usedDate = await getInfo(img.date().format('YYYY-MM-dd')); return { image: img, size: size, source: ds, usedDate: usedDate, window: w.label }; } } } return null; } async function computeStats(img, geom) { const band = 'NDSI_Snow_Cover'; const snow = img.select(band); const validMask = snow.gte(0).and(snow.lte(100)); const snowValid = snow.updateMask(validMask); const scale = 1000; const totalDict = await getInfo(ee.Image(1).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true })); const totalCount = (totalDict && totalDict.constant) ? totalDict.constant : 0; const validCountDict = await getInfo(snowValid.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true })); const validCount = (validCountDict && validCountDict[band]) ? validCountDict[band] : 0; let meanDict = null; let mean = null; if (validCount > 0) { meanDict = await getInfo(snowValid.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true })); mean = meanDict ? meanDict[band] : null; } const cloudInvalidPct = (totalCount > 0) ? (100.0 * (totalCount - validCount) / totalCount) : null; return { totalCount, validCount, cloudInvalidPct, mean }; } async function runAnalysis() { try { const geom = nwPennsylvaniaGeometry(); // Dates of interest const dateA = '2020-02-22'; const dateB = '2020-03-01'; // Fetch images (with fallbacks) const fetchA = await fetchSnowImage(dateA, geom); const fetchB = await fetchSnowImage(dateB, geom); if (!fetchA || !fetchB) { if (!fetchA) console.log(`No images found around ${dateA}.`); if (!fetchB) console.log(`No images found around ${dateB}.`); console.log('C1'); return; } // Compute stats const statsA = await computeStats(fetchA.image, geom); const statsB = await computeStats(fetchB.image, geom); // Validate counts if ((statsA.totalCount || 0) === 0 || (statsB.totalCount || 0) === 0) { console.log('Total pixels at scale are zero (region/scale issue).'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (statsA.validCount === 0 || statsB.validCount === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Validate means const meanA = statsA.mean; const meanB = statsB.mean; const invalidMean = (v) => (v === null || isNaN(v) || v < 0 || v > 100); if (invalidMean(meanA) || invalidMean(meanB)) { console.log('Mean snow percent invalid (null/NaN/out of range).'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Print concise evidence console.log(`A ${fetchA.usedDate} src:${fetchA.source} imgs:${fetchA.size} totalPix:${statsA.totalCount} validPix:${statsA.validCount} cloud/invalid%:${statsA.cloudInvalidPct.toFixed(1)} meanSnow%:${meanA.toFixed(1)}`); console.log(`B ${fetchB.usedDate} src:${fetchB.source} imgs:${fetchB.size} totalPix:${statsB.totalCount} validPix:${statsB.validCount} cloud/invalid%:${statsB.cloudInvalidPct.toFixed(1)} meanSnow%:${meanB.toFixed(1)}`); const delta = meanB - meanA; console.log(`Delta meanSnow% (B - A): ${delta.toFixed(1)}`); // Final answer: Did snow cover increase? if (delta > 0) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } catch (err) { console.error(String(err)); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
